note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source describes only the soldier, and the alate and worker are not described. Synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown, fontanelle gland area pale yellow; nasus reddish brown; antennae brownish; pronotum deep straw-coloured; abdominal tergites brownish, sternites yellowish white. Head covered with numerous microscopic setae, base of the nasus with 1 pair of longer setae and vertex with 1 pair; apex of the nasus with several long setae and some microscopic setae; pronotum hairy; abdominal tergites densely covered with short setae; the first 5 tergites without long setae, the remaining tergites each with 1 pair of longer setae on the lateral margins and 1 pair in the middle; sternites with short and long setae. Body length 3.0–3.4 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped (length with nasus 1.55–1.60, length without nasus 0.90–1.0, maximum width 0.90–0.95 mm); in lateral view straight, nasus hump weak; weakly constricted behind the antennae; posterior margin rounded. Nasus weakly conical (length 0.60–0.65 mm, nasus length/head length index 0.65–0.72). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 the shortest. Mandibles reduced, each with a short conical process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.15, width 0.40 mm); middle of the anterior margin slightly concave; posterior margin straight.
